description: This file contains unit tests for the WifiManager plugin using Google Test framework. It tests various API handlers, internal methods, and event subscriptions related to Wi-Fi management functionality such as scanning, connection, configuration, and events handling.

classes.name: WifiManagerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WifiManager API tests, setting up mocks and plugin instance.

classes.name: WifiInitializedEventTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture for testing Wi-Fi initialization events, like WIFI state change and SSID updates.

methods.name: TestedAPIsShouldExist
methods.description: Checks the existence of various API handlers supported by WifiManager.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Tests the setEnabled API call, mocking the IARM bus call to enable or disable Wi-Fi.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Tests retrieving the Wi-Fi current state via the handler.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Tests fetching the paired SSID, including cache behavior and failure conditions.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Tests retrieving detailed info of the paired SSID, including success and failure conditions.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Tests fetching the currently connected SSID and associated parameters.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Tests the connect API, mocking the bus call to connect to a Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Tests disconnect API, ensuring proper bus call invocation.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Tests saving an SSID with security parameters.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Tests clearing the stored SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Tests checking if a device is paired, with cache and failure scenarios.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Tests starting an SSID scan process, both incremental and full.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Tests stopping the ongoing scan process.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Tests invoking WPS pairing cancel.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Tests starting WPS pairing process.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing2
methods.description: Tests the 'initiateWPSPairing2' method with specific parameters, returning success or failure.

methods.name: SignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Tests getting and setting Wi-Fi signal threshold change enabled status.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Tests retrieving supported Wi-Fi security modes.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Tests fetching device-specific quirks or peculiar behaviors.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler test simulating a Wi-Fi state change event.

methods.name: onSSIDsChanged
methods.description: Event handler test for when SSIDs list updates.

methods.name: onWifiSignalThresholdChanged
methods.description: Event handler for Wi-Fi signal quality threshold change.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Event handler for error notifications.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Event handler for the available SSIDs list.
